statement: The additive finite adeles embed in the automorphism group of the full universal pro-cover of P1 minus three points, fixing a chosen cusp, with cyclotomic conjugation under a continuous tangential Galois action and stabilizer Zhat of the base modular coordinate.
where_proved: sections/D_extension.tex, D.10; detailed cross-review note audit/F_D5_construction.md
depends_on: Classical modular lambda uniformization and q expansion, CDT2025 p628 equation1.0.2; SGA1 XII5.1; elementary rational commensuration and algebraic-germ descent
manuscript_passages: MPL149, Conjectures B and B-prime, scans59-63; prompt R22 and D5
doubtful_reading: No new reading proposed; completed points mean geometric closed pro-points, not generic scheme points.
notes: Complete proof independently reviewed and accepted by the root agent. Rational translations and cusp inertia are checked on faithful Puiseux germs. The proof preserves the affine pro-curve ring, not only its function field; it does not assume unique roots in the full automorphism group. Proper normalization at finite levels extends the action to the completed pro-cover.

statement: There exists an abstract semilinear G_Q action on the universal pro-cover that normalizes no deck group of any finite hyperbolic quotient and has exactly one G_Q^circ-fixed completed pro-point, its selected cusp.
where_proved: sections/D_extension.tex, D.11; detailed cross-review note audit/F_D5_construction.md
depends_on: D.10; elementary finite Kummer extensions and commutator calculation; a Z_l-linear functional on product Z_l with values l^(-i); F.3 or the abelian Kummer argument in D.7; finiteness of automorphisms of a hyperbolic curve
manuscript_passages: MPL149, Conjectures B and B-prime, scans59-63; prompt R19,R22,D5
doubtful_reading: No new reading proposed; the example satisfies the fixed-point conclusion and is not a counterexample to the universal first clause of D5.
notes: Complete proof independently reviewed and accepted by the root agent. The cocycle is unbounded and has dense kernel on G_Q^circ. Its infinite coordinate orbit excludes every normalized finite quotient; density reduces its fixed set to the original continuous tangential action. Settles D5's second demand, while leaving the universal fixed-point assertion unresolved. The functional uses a vector-space basis and the axiom of choice; it is not an effective cocycle algorithm.
